paragraphs.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
paragraphs.original: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν δίκαιον·
paragraphs.translit: Ta tekna, hypakouete tois goneusin hymōn en kyriō, touto gar estin dikaion·

paragraphs.text: Honor thy father and mother (which is the first commandment with promise),
paragraphs.original: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ,
paragraphs.translit: tima ton patera sou kai tēn mētera, hētis estin entolē prōtē en epangelia,

paragraphs.text: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
paragraphs.translit: hina eu soi genētai kai esē makrochronios epi tēs gēs.

paragraphs.text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες, μὴ παροργίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ κυρίου.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hoi pateres, mē parorgizete ta tekna hymōn, alla ektrephete auta en paideia kai nouthesia kyriou.

paragraphs.text: Servants, be obedient unto them that according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
paragraphs.original: Οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ,
paragraphs.translit: Hoi douloi, hypakouete tois kata sarka kyriois meta phobou kai tromou en haplotēti tēs kardias hymōn hōs tō Christō,

paragraphs.text: not in the way of eyeservice, as men-pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
paragraphs.original: μὴ κατʼ ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἀλλʼ ὡς δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐκ ψυχῆς
paragraphs.translit: mē katʼ ophthalmodoulian hōs anthrōpareskoi allʼ hōs douloi Christou poiountes to thelēma tou theou, ek psychēs

paragraphs.text: with good will doing service, as unto the Lord, and not unto men:
paragraphs.original: μετʼ εὐνοίας δουλεύοντες, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,
paragraphs.translit: metʼ eunoias douleuontes, hōs tō kyriō kai ouk anthrōpois,

paragraphs.text: knowing that whatsoever good thing each one doeth, the same shall he receive again from the Lord, whether [he be] bond or free.
paragraphs.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ἕκαστος, ὃ ἂν ποιήσῃ ἀγαθόν, τοῦτο κομίσεται παρὰ κυρίου, εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος.
paragraphs.translit: eidotes hoti hekastos, ho an poiēsē agathon, touto komisetai para kyriou, eite doulos eite eleutheros.

paragraphs.text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, and forbear threatening: knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no respect of persons with him.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ οἱ κύριοι, τὰ αὐτὰ ποιεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς, ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν ὁ κύριός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ προσωπολημψία οὐκ ἔστιν παρʼ αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hoi kyrioi, ta auta poieite pros autous, anientes tēn apeilēn, eidotes hoti kai autōn kai hymōn ho kyrios estin en ouranois, kai prosōpolēmpsia ouk estin parʼ autō.

paragraphs.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
paragraphs.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Tou loipou endynamousthe en kyriō kai en tō kratei tēs ischyos autou.

paragraphs.text: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
paragraphs.original: ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς τὸ δύνασθαι ὑμᾶς στῆναι πρὸς τὰς μεθοδείας τοῦ διαβόλου·
paragraphs.translit: endysasthe tēn panoplian tou theou pros to dynasthai hymas stēnai pros tas methodeias tou diabolou·

paragraphs.text: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual [hosts] of wickedness in the heavenly [places].
paragraphs.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη πρὸς αἷμα καὶ σάρκα, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς, πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας, πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ σκότους τούτου, πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις.
paragraphs.translit: hoti ouk estin hēmin hē palē pros haima kai sarka, alla pros tas archas, pros tas exousias, pros tous kosmokratoras tou skotous toutou, pros ta pneumatika tēs ponērias en tois epouraniois.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore take up the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ καὶ ἅπαντα κατεργασάμενοι στῆναι.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto analabete tēn panoplian tou theou, hina dynēthēte antistēnai en tē hēmera tē ponēra kai hapanta katergasamenoi stēnai.

paragraphs.text: Stand therefore, having girded your loins with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
paragraphs.original: στῆτε οὖν περιζωσάμενοι τὴν ὀσφὺν ὑμῶν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης,
paragraphs.translit: stēte oun perizōsamenoi tēn osphyn hymōn en alētheia, kai endysamenoi ton thōraka tēs dikaiosynēs,

paragraphs.text: and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑποδησάμενοι τοὺς πόδας ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης,
paragraphs.translit: kai hypodēsamenoi tous podas en hetoimasia tou euangeliou tēs eirēnēs,

paragraphs.text: withal taking up the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil [one].
paragraphs.original: ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως, ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε πάντα τὰ βέλη τοῦ πονηροῦ πεπυρωμένα σβέσαι·
paragraphs.translit: en pasin analabontes ton thyreon tēs pisteōs, en hō dynēsesthe panta ta belē tou ponērou pepyrōmena sbesai·

paragraphs.text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου δέξασθε, καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ πνεύματος, ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: kai tēn perikephalaian tou sōtēriou dexasthe, kai tēn machairan tou pneumatos, ho estin rhēma theou,

paragraphs.text: with all prayer and supplication praying at all seasons in the Spirit, and watching thereunto in all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,
paragraphs.original: διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως, προσευχόμενοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἐν πνεύματι, καὶ εἰς αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων,
paragraphs.translit: dia pasēs proseuchēs kai deēseōs, proseuchomenoi en panti kairō en pneumati, kai eis auto agrypnountes en pasē proskarterēsei kai deēsei peri pantōn tōn hagiōn,

paragraphs.text: And on my behalf, that utterance may be given unto me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα μοι δοθῇ λόγος ἐν ἀνοίξει τοῦ στόματός μου, ἐν παρρησίᾳ γνωρίσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
paragraphs.translit: kai hyper emou, hina moi dothē logos en anoixei tou stomatos mou, en parrēsia gnōrisai to mystērion tou euangeliou

paragraphs.text: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
paragraphs.original: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ παρρησιάσωμαι ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.
paragraphs.translit: hyper hou presbeuō en halysei, hina en autō parrēsiasōmai hōs dei me lalēsai.

paragraphs.text: But that ye also may know my affairs, how I do, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
paragraphs.original: Ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ κατʼ ἐμέ, τί πράσσω, πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος ἐν κυρίῳ,
paragraphs.translit: Hina de eidēte kai hymeis ta katʼ eme, ti prassō, panta gnōrisei hymin Tychikos ho agapētos adelphos kai pistos diakonos en kyriō,

paragraphs.text: whom I have sent unto you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.
paragraphs.original: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hon epempsa pros hymas eis auto touto hina gnōte ta peri hēmōn kai parakalesē tas kardias hymōn.

paragraphs.text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: Εἰρήνη τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καὶ ἀγάπη μετὰ πίστεως ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Eirēnē tois adelphois kai agapē meta pisteōs apo theou patros kai kyriou Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ with [a love] incorruptible.
paragraphs.original: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: hē charis meta pantōn tōn agapōntōn ton kyrion hēmōn Iēsoun Christon en aphtharsia.
